verdict.rationale: PostHog documents extensive natural-language control surfaces (PostHog AI chat, MCP 'plain text questions' to ship flags/run SQL, Slack agent, CLI/wizard) letting users operate the product conversationally, e.g. posthog-docs-35, posthog-supp-posthog-ai-analyst, posthog-docs-19/24/31, posthog-supp-slack-agent. However, a hands-on community report (posthog-comm-8) describes the LLM/natural-language integration failing outright (unable to create a SQL-based cohort despite being asked to) and causing severe UI performance degradation, directly contradicting the polished vendor narrative. Missing for 10: broader independent corroboration that natural-language commands reliably work across products, and no vendor acknowledgment/fix of the reported failure mode.
